title: PH, Japan look to strengthen security, economic partnership
summary: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae discussed about advancing shared priorities through stronger security and economic partnerships at the 49th ASEAN Summit,…

blocks.text: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae discussed continued cooperation between the two countries at the sidelines of the 49th ASEAN Summit. Photo Presidential Communications Office

President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae discussed about advancing shared priorities through stronger security and economic partnerships at the 49th ASEAN Summit, the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) reported.

"Continued cooperation on defense and security, economic development, and energy resilience will help advance shared priorities and strengthen the foundations of the bilateral partnership," the PCO said.

The two leaders, meeting at the sidelines of the regional leaders' meeting, reaffirmed the Philippines-Japan Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and committed to closer collaboration on defense and security, economic cooperation, and energy resilience.
Marcos and Sanae also discussed Japan’s valuable support for Philippine development priorities and key infrastructure programs. — BAP, GMA News
